# EW1: PRODUCT’S END OF LIFE

**Pillar:** Environmental Criteria  
**Points:** 1

## Description
The product is locally compostable by the end user or can be incorporated into a local energy-recovery system that does not involve landfill or thermal treatment.

## Why it matters
The product can be composted or used as fuel or food.
